name: Trace
description: Trace gives agents structured data on what technologies companies use, who they partner with, and who they're hiring. Ask about any company's tech stack, integration ecosystem, or recent hiring signals, and Trace returns structured answers. Create lists to monitor changes over time. Useful for account research, market analysis, competitive insights, or spotting when a company adopts a new tool or partner.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tracedata.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trace MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trace lists 15 MCP tools, including company_detail, company_partnered_with, company_profile, company_uses_technology, find_companies, find_companies_using_technology, flag_company_data, lists_admin, lists_edit, lists_filter_fields, lists_members, and lists_read.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trace?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Trace in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Trace requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trace is developed by Trace. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
